label.description: Accessible name of the navigation landmark.

max-items.description:
Optional overflow threshold. Above it, keep the first and last two levels
visible. Positive values are rounded down and clamped to four. Omit this
prop, or pass a non-positive or non-finite value, to show the full trail.

more-label.description: Localizable name of the overflow control. Use {n} for the hidden level count.

--ki-breadcrumb-bg.description: Transparent backing for ancestor text and the overflow trigger.

--ki-breadcrumb-current-bg.description: Transparent backing for the current level.

--ki-breadcrumb-current-fg.description: Emphasized foreground of the current level.

--ki-breadcrumb-fg.description: Medium-emphasis ink for ancestors and the overflow trigger, strengthened in more-contrast mode.

--ki-breadcrumb-gap.description: Gap between breadcrumb rows, levels and their chevrons.

--ki-breadcrumb-hover-bg.description: Backing for the active overflow trigger and highlighted overflow links.

--ki-breadcrumb-hover-fg.description: Foreground for the active overflow trigger and highlighted overflow links.

--ki-breadcrumb-menu-backdrop-filter.description: Complete backdrop filter of the overflow menu, none by default.

--ki-breadcrumb-menu-bg.description: Surface behind the overflow menu entries.

--ki-breadcrumb-menu-bg-image.description: Optional image layered over the overflow menu surface.

--ki-breadcrumb-menu-max-block-size.description: Maximum block size of the scrollable overflow menu.

--ki-breadcrumb-menu-padding.description: Inset around the overflow menu entries.

--ki-breadcrumb-menu-radius.description: Outer radius of the overflow menu.

--ki-breadcrumb-menu-shadow.description: Elevation of the overflow menu above the page.

--ki-breadcrumb-padding-block.description: Block inset of a level label.

--ki-breadcrumb-padding-inline.description: Inline inset of a level label.

--ki-breadcrumb-radius.description: Radius of the overflow trigger and level focus outlines.

--ki-breadcrumb-separator.description: Foreground of the decorative breadcrumb chevron.

--ki-breadcrumb-separator-size.description: Edge length of the decorative chevron before rotation.

--ki-breadcrumb-separator-stroke.description: Stroke width of the decorative chevron.

--ki-density-target-min.description: The smallest pointer target any density may produce: 24 x 24 CSS px by default and in compact (WCAG 2.5.8 AA), 44 x 44 in touch (WCAG 2.5.5). It floors a shrinking control but never lifts what a control paints: a control painted smaller extends its target to it, invisibly; rows and tabs grow to it (spec 045 A1).

--ki-focus-ring-color.description: Colour of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws: 3:1 or more against the page in every theme and scheme.

--ki-focus-ring-offset.description: Gap between a focusable component and its keyboard focus ring.

--ki-focus-ring-width.description: Thickness of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws (its outline). One token instead of one per component, so a mode or a theme changes every ring at once.

--ki-typography-family-body.description: semantic font family for typography family body.

--ki-typography-line-height-body-1.description: semantic dimension for typography line height body 1.

--ki-typography-size-body-1.description: semantic dimension for typography size body 1.

--ki-typography-underline-offset.description: Gap between text and its underline.

--ki-typography-weight-body-medium.description: semantic font weight for typography weight body medium.

component.description: A path of ancestor links ending at the current page, with optional overflow.

label.description: The label of an ancestor with no destination.

list.description: The ordered list of visible levels.

list-item.description: A list entry for a level or the overflow control.

menu.description: The anchored menu of collapsed levels.

menu-item.description: A destination or unavailable level in the overflow menu.

label.description: Accessible name of the navigation landmark.

maxItems.description:
Optional overflow threshold. Above it, keep the first and last two levels
visible. Positive values are rounded down and clamped to four. Omit this
prop, or pass a non-positive or non-finite value, to show the full trail.

moreLabel.description: Localizable name of the overflow control. Use {n} for the hidden level count.

slots.description: Direct ki-breadcrumb-item children in hierarchy order.
